thread: nina: Heads-up — nightly docs build tripped linkcheck. Many fragments point to headings where the slugifier inserted directional/control chars. ci-bot: mkdocs-linkcheck failed: 5 broken fragments detected. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/builds/12345/logs nina: Quick excerpt from the artifact: `` ERROR - file:///workspace/site/guides/setup.html: broken link: /docs/guides/setup#env-vars -> fragment not found (expected id: env-vars‎) `` marcos: U+200E (LRM) again. These keep coming from copy/paste into code blocks or headings. elaine: Suggested triage: 1) short-term: add explicit fallback anchors for the busiest pages so linkcheck doesn't block releases, 2) medium-term: add a docs CI check to fail if source files contain U+200B/U+200E/U+200F, 3) long-term: run a repo-wide normalization and add guidance to CONTRIBUTING.md. nina: Agreed. I'll open a tiny docs PR that adds anchors (``) above affected headings and a note comment explaining it's temporary. Also will add a limited `.linkcheck-ignore` entry. marcos: I'll own the CI lint. Plan: a small Node script `scripts/find-control-chars.js` used by `npm run docs-lint` that greps files and fails if any of those codepoints exist. I'll add it to pre-commit too. elaine: Please include a unit test in `tests/docs/test_no_control_chars.py` so the CI check is explicit. Also add a short README blurb describing how to run the fixer locally. nina: PRs opened: docs fallback anchors + ignore: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3123, control-char lint + test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3124. Both include descriptions and screenshots. ci-bot: docs PR #3123 checks started. marcos: Implementation note: the script will scan `.md`/`.mdx` and show filename:line:hexcode for each occurrence. Example output: `docs/guides/setup.md:42:U+200E`. We'll include an optional `--fix` flag that strips them (but default will only report). elaine: Nice. For the fallback anchors, please use `aria-hidden="true"` and an HTML comment like ``. We want reviewers to know it's temporary. nina: Done in #3123. I squashed the content fallback into one commit for easy revert. marcos: #3124 added the lint and the unit test. CI will fail until content PR with anchors is merged (linkcheck will be unblocked by the `.linkcheck-ignore` in #3123). After both land we'll run the normalization with `--fix` in a follow-up PR. nina: Requesting reviewers: @elaine on #3123 and @marcos on #3124. I'll ping QA for manual anchor checks on mobile once staging rebuild is green. elaine: QA note — when testing anchors on mobile, check scroll offset with the top nav and any sticky header CSS (we previously saw content hidden under the header). If offset needed, we can add `scroll-margin-top` to headings in the docs CSS. marcos: Good call. I'll add a tiny visual regression checklist in the lint PR so QA knows what to validate. ci-bot: /retest queued after #3123 merge. nina: Thanks — I'll follow up with a cleanup PR to remove the fallback anchors after the normalization and lint land. Closing loop here, will post status updates. :thumbsup:
